value.name: Micky asks Jimmy to reach Laurie
value.description: Micky tells Jimmy he cannot speak to Laurie himself and asks Jimmy to help him get through to her.
evidence: MICKY I'm asking YOU, Jimmy. I can't talk to her, so I'm asking YOU.

value.name: Kasie greets her father
value.description: Kasie comes to the door and hugs Micky hello when Jimmy calls her over.
evidence: JIMMY Kasie, talk to your father.
Micky's daughter, KASIE WARD, 10, curly hair, cute, comes up to the door, hugs her father hello.

value.name: Kasie mentions Micky's upcoming fight
value.description: Through the doorway, Kasie acknowledges that her father is fighting Saoul Mamby.
evidence: KASIE (through the doorway) Daddy's gotta fight Saoul Mamby-

value.name: Micky promises a win and better future
value.description: Micky tells Kasie that he expects to win the fight and use the success to improve his life and theirs.
evidence: MICKY That's right, and I wanna tell ya that after I win --
MICKY I'm gonna staht makin' good money.
MICKY I'll move to a biggah apahtment so you can live with me more days like we talked about.

value.name: Laurie rejects Micky's promises
value.description: Laurie interrupts and dismisses Micky's claims about the future, telling him not to mislead Kasie.
evidence: LAURIE Talk to her on your days!
LAURIE Hah! That's a good one!
LAURIE Don't hold ya breath, Kasie. It's cruel to mislead ya child, Micky.

value.name: Laurie closes the door
value.description: Laurie shuts the door on Micky and continues arguing with Jimmy inside.
evidence: She closes the door, arguing inside with Jimmy.

value.name: Kasie wishes Micky luck
value.description: After the door closes, Kasie shouts through it to wish her father luck in his fight.
evidence: KASIE (shouts through door) Good luck, Daddy!

value.name: Micky thanks Kasie through the door
value.description: Micky responds to Kasie's farewell by thanking her from outside the closed door.
